tagline_en: A double-ampoule salon facial for brighter, dewier skin
tagline_zh: 美白 + 补水双安瓶护理
overview_en: A professional double-ampoule salon facial (whitening ampoule + hydrating ampoule) paired with a Medic Ice mask that visibly evens pigmentation, smooths texture and boosts radiance — before-and-after shows brighter, finer, more luminous skin.
